description: This file defines the Cache_Lite class, a lightweight, fast, and safe caching system for PHP, including methods for caching, retrieving, cleaning, and error handling, with support for file locking, cache validation, serialization, and directory management.

classes.name: Cache_Lite
classes.description: A PHP class implementing a lightweight, file-based caching system with features like cache validation, file locking, serialization, and directory management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes Cache_Lite with configuration options such as cache directory, caching behavior, lifetime, locking, serialization, and directory structure.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached data by ID and group, with optional cache validity testing and memory caching support.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Stores data in cache with specified ID and group, handling serialization, memory caching, and cache cleaning.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Deletes a cache file by ID and group.

methods.name: clean
methods.description: Cleans cache files based on group and mode ('old', 'ingroup', etc.).

methods.name: setToDebug
methods.description: Sets error mode to stop execution on errors for debugging.

methods.name: setLifeTime
methods.description: Updates cache lifetime and refresh time.

methods.name: saveMemoryCachingState
methods.description: Saves the current memory cache state to a cache file.

methods.name: getMemoryCachingState
methods.description: Loads memory cache state from a cache file.

methods.name: lastModified
methods.description: Returns the last modification time of the cache file.

methods.name: raiseError
methods.description: Triggers a PEAR error with a message and code.
